name: Highwaymen MC
description: The Highwaymen MC is a one-percenter outlaw motorcycle club founded in 1954 in Detroit, Michigan. The largest outlaw motorcycle club in Michigan, it maintains chapters in Alabama, Florida, Indiana, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, and Tennessee, with influence across the Midwest and South. Members are predominantly African American.
symbols: Winged Skeleton Wearing Motorcycle Cap And Leather Jacket
